messages:
lina: FYI premerge SAST + DAST started failing on ci-redwood, looks tied to KMS decrypt errors when scanner fetches test fixtures. link: https://ci.redwood.example/build/2789 :warning:
omar: saw that too, curious whether it coincided with last-night's RBAC change. anyone on keystore?
kevin: we changed key binding conditions in key policy at 02:10 UTC to restrict to a specific service principal. that might be the cause.
lina: log excerpt:
```
ERROR scanner: failed to decrypt test-fixture: AccessDeniedException: Caller not permitted to use key
  at kmsclient.Decrypt (keystore_client.go:201)
  at scanner.LoadFixtures (scanner/fixtures.go:72)
```
carol: key policy now has condition requiring `request.auth.aud == "keystore-service"` which ephemeral tokens lack.
omar: are other services affected or only CI-scanner? quick check shows long-lived services unaffected. ephemeral consumers fail.
kevin: confirms. ephemeral-grants issues tokens without that aud claim.
lina: immediate blockers: preserve failing artifacts and capture KMS policy snapshot + IAM audit. I'll take artifacts. :white_check_mark:
security-bot: evidence ticket created: SEC-EVID-2026-93 with artifact bucket link.
omar: proposed short-term options: (1) patch key policy to include ephemeral-grants principal for short window, (2) update ephemeral-grants to mint tokens with required aud claim, (3) have CI step impersonate keystore SA.\e
kevin: option 2 is preferable but needs PR review and rollout. option 1 is fastest to unblock.
carol: we need 2 approvers for emergency key-policy edits per keystore runbook. @lina can you get approvals?
lina: will route approvals. I need a minimal JSON snippet for the policy patch, kevin can draft?
kevin: drafting patch: add member `serviceAccount:ephemeral-grants@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` to roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter with condition limiting to `timestamp < "2026-03-22T04:00:00Z"` and resource path filter. paste in channel momentarily.
kevin: patch JSON:
```json
{"bindings": [{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter","members":["serviceAccount:ephemeral-grants@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"],"condition":{"title":"ci-temp-unblock","expression":"request.time < timestamp(\"2026-03-22T04:00:00Z\")"}}]}
```
lina: tagging oncall and compliance. need two approvals.
carol: I approve the emergency patch to unblock CI, provided we log approvers and revert window is short. :+1:
omar: approved as well. :heavy_check_mark:
deploy-bot: policy patch applied by kevin at 02:45 UTC (audit-id: z9y8x7).
security-bot: incident created SEC-INC-2026-27 responders: lina, kevin, carol, omar.
kevin: re-triggered build 2790. scanners returned green. https://ci.redwood.example/build/2790 :rocket:
lina: next steps: 1) ephemeral-grants PR to add aud claim and CI integration tests (owner: omar) 2) add a CI preflight that validates KMS decrypt before runner runs (owner: lina) 3) update keystore deploy runbook to call out key-policy diffs and require staging validation (owner: carol)
omar: I'll open the PR and include unit tests and an integration test against a staging KMS key.
carol: I'll update runbook and add a checklist item.
lina: thanks team — preserving this thread as canonical evidence chain. I'll link SEC-EVID-2026-93 and SEC-INC-2026-27 in the postmortem.
